title: Record a registered launcher run's terminal result as typed test evidence without a turn grant (gated control ON and OFF)
outcome: Record a registered launcher run's terminal result as typed test evidence without a turn grant (gated control ON and OFF)
acceptance: A registered launcher run's terminal result is recorded through the existing host transport as typed verification evidence, against the actual project/store/session/work/run/claim/named-root association pinned at registration, with honest host-run provenance and its actual Git input (full commit, or the staged tree for the staged review/gate lane). This works with gated control ON and OFF, without a fabricated grant or turn, a later focus, execution_observe credit:none, or exit-code prose.
It reuses the canonical verification persistence, matcher and idempotent exact-intent settlement; a retry of the same intent records nothing new, and a failed run records a failed result.

Tests cover ON and OFF recording, retry, a failed run, and a record whose association does not validate against the pinned project, store, session, work, run, claim and named root, including one never pinned by a registration (refused, nothing recorded). That the host sends a record only for a durably registered run is the sender's boundary, a required criterion on TermAl w-decd61d62831.
Host-protocol documentation and docs/shipped.md describe the producer. If the durable shape changes, the explicit import and readiness rules are followed.

completion.summary: Landed and installed the grant-free registered-run verification producer with canonical replay, honest failed results, and tested never-pinned association refusals. Exact commit 20dda026cf801a17a7138810ed1f74a6aed69c3a passed the full gate, clean release, all six live-store readiness checks, and fresh independent acceptance 4/4.
